rows.source_title: ΦΕΚ Α' 160/07.09.2021: Νόμος 4826/2021, Ταμείο Επικουρικής Κεφαλαιοποιητικής Ασφάλισης (Τ.Ε.Κ.Α.)
rows.label: Mandatory occupational pension: funded auxiliary pension fund (Ταμείο Επικουρικής Κεφαλαιοποιητικής Ασφάλισης (Τ.Ε.Κ.Α.)) [national]
rows.value: Funded individual accounts; mandatory for everyone first insured from 1 January 2022, instead of the e-EFKA auxiliary pension branch; employee and employer contributions collected by e-EFKA. Paid by employees and employers (new entrants from 2022). Νόμος 4826/2021 art. 6, 8 and 43.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Greece: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item D4
rows.source_title: ΦΕΚ Α' 21/14.02.2025: Νόμος 5177/2025, Κώδικας εμμέσων φόρων, art. 43 (insurance premium tax)
rows.label: Insurance premium tax (φόρος ασφαλίστρων) [national]
rows.value: 20% on fire insurance premiums, 4% on life insurance, 15% on other classes. Paid by insurers (Greek and foreign insurers and their tax representatives), passed on in the premium. Κώδικας εμμέσων φόρων (Νόμος 5177/2025) art. 43.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Greece: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item D5
rows.source_title: ΦΕΚ Α' 134/28.07.2025: Νόμος 5222/2025, Εθνικός Τελωνειακός Κώδικας, art. 71 (excise rates on energy products and electricity)
rows.label: Excise duty on electricity (Ειδικός Φόρος Κατανάλωσης ηλεκτρικής ενέργειας) [national]
rows.value: EUR 5 per MWh for business use (EUR 2 for high and medium voltage consumption above 10,000 MWh a year); EUR 2.20 per MWh for households; EUR 5 for other uses; natural gas for heating EUR 0.30 per GJ (households) or EUR 1.50. Paid by electricity and gas suppliers, passed on to consumers. Εθνικός Τελωνειακός Κώδικας (Νόμος 5222/2025) art. 71.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Greece: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item F1; detailed table: vehicle-taxes
rows.source_title: ΦΕΚ Α' 134/28.07.2025: Νόμος 5222/2025, Εθνικός Τελωνειακός Κώδικας, art. 136 (registration tax on private passenger cars)
rows.label: Motor vehicle registration tax (τέλος ταξινόμησης) [national]
rows.value: Private cars: progressive scale on the taxable value, 4% up to EUR 14,000, then 26%, 53%, 62% and 71% up to EUR 30,000 and 30% above, adjusted by CO2 emissions (-5% to +100%); motorcycles 0% to 11% by engine size; the annual road tax is not stored. Paid by buyers or importers registering a vehicle in Greece. Εθνικός Τελωνειακός Κώδικας (Νόμος 5222/2025) art. 136.

rows.note: Checklist item F2
rows.source_title: ΦΕΚ Α' 170/2017: Νόμος 4496/2017, packaging, Directive 2015/720/EU (environmental fee on plastic carrier bags)
rows.label: Environmental fee on lightweight plastic carrier bags (περιβαλλοντικό τέλος πλαστικής σακούλας) [national]
rows.value: EUR 0.07 per bag before VAT (from 1 January 2019); very lightweight and compostable bags exempt. Paid by consumers (collected by the shop and paid to AADE for the recycling agency). Νόμος 4496/2017.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Greece: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item H1
rows.source_title: ΦΕΚ Α' 21/14.02.2025: Νόμος 5177/2025, Κώδικας εμμέσων φόρων (Book One: Ψηφιακό Τέλος Συναλλαγής, replacing stamp duty)
rows.label: Stamp duty on documents and contracts: replaced by the digital transaction fee (Ψηφιακό Τέλος Συναλλαγής) [national]
rows.value: Stamp duty abolished from 1 December 2024; the digital transaction fee is 3.6%, 2.4% or 1.2% of the value by type of transaction (e.g. 3.6% on commercial leases outside VAT), plus fixed fees. Paid by parties to the transactions listed in the law. Κώδικας εμμέσων φόρων (Νόμος 5177/2025), Book One; Νόμος 5162/2024 art. 128.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Greece: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item H2
rows.source_title: ΦΕΚ Α' 212/25.11.2025: Νόμος 5253/2025, art. 8 (new art. 6Α of law 4173/2013: ERT licence fee)
rows.label: Broadcasting licence fee (ERT fee) (ανταποδοτικό τέλος ΕΡΤ) [national]
rows.value: EUR 3 a month per electricity supply, charged on electricity bills. Paid by holders of electricity supplies. Νόμος 4173/2013 art. 6Α (added by Νόμος 5253/2025, in force from 1 September 2026; previously art. 6 (3), same amount).
